newsitem.title: UK: LASMO says completes well in south Italy.
newsitem.headline: LASMO says completes well in south Italy.

text.p: Oil exploration company LASMO Plc said on Thursday that, with its partners, it had successfully completed the Gorgoglione well in the Tempa Rossa field in southern Italy.
The well has drilled to a depth of 5,365 metres and is the deepest tested in the Tempa Rossa field so far.
The well flows at rates up to 6,725 barrels per day of 20.3 degree API oil at a wellhead pressure of 458 pounds per square inch, LASMO said.
"A decision to develop the Tempa Rossa field is now expected before the end of 1997," John Hogan, LASMO's chief operating officer, said.
